paper: Uncovering the dynamics of precise repair at CRISPR/Cas9-induced double-strand breaks
organism_and_assay: Tomato protoplasts; UMI-DSBseq; not Arabidopsis embryonic development
data_scope: Authors' public Psy1 example count table. Not asserted identical to the final paper Source Data workbook. No author R code is redistributed.
column_evidence: csv2timecourse.R selects time,WT.Sub,indels,preciseDSB,impreciseDSB before renaming to time,y1,y2,y3,y4; predict_models in likelihood_functions.R confirms that order. The repository README describes a conflicting order.
held_out: Both 72-hour replicates; all earlier times are training. No random row split.
interpretation: Reported effective repair rates serve as transfer/sensitivity references. Cellular expression, target engagement, product release, volumes, division and synthetic repair-allele probabilities remain scenario assumptions.
